paperclip_referent: paperclipai/paperclip (verified canonical GitHub org; user typed papercliped)
notes: Do not blindly subsume another agent orchestrator. Paperclip and Gas Town overlap with canonical state; adopt mechanisms only after dedup/eval.
Existing prior-art registry already includes OpenHands and LangGraph and CrewAI. This supplemental list adds evidence for reconciled promotion, not duplicate PA IDs.
Repo licenses inferred from current GitHub metadata only for Paperclip, Gas Town, Hatchet, Models.dev and Vibe Kanban. Other licenses need exact verification before copying source.
Paperclip has operational complexity: Node/React/Postgres; wrapping versus borrowing must be empirically compared.
No new agents installed, no remote processes started, no credentials granted.

entries.name: Paperclip
entries.features_to_consider: Atomic task checkout, heartbeat wake/resume, scoped goal ancestry, explicit org/agent/project budgets, revisioned approval/rollback, skill test and retention, reversible connection permissions, portable agent-team templates.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Orchestrator already has typed records, EVS/CAP evidence, tasks/checkpoints, budgets/approval and provider-neutral adapters. Avoid a second company/org database; map Paperclip concept to the existing canonical project IDs and scoped task locks.
entries.proposed_validation: Implement only tested gap-by-gap mechanisms: competing-checkout test, run lease with heartbeat and expiry, approval-driven wake, per-project cost view, mobile read-only progress; compare implementation complexity vs wrapper. No deployment yet.

entries.name: Gas Town
entries.features_to_consider: Convoys and beads, manager/worker role boundaries, worktree isolation, durable handoffs, refinery merge queue and collision prevention.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Orchestrator owns execution and Git integration; must not duplicate queues/checkpoints. Worktree merge queue and dependency readiness could enhance multi-agent workloads.
entries.proposed_validation: Prototype a deterministic staging/merge queue on an isolated test repo; task graph dependency and idempotent resume tests.

entries.name: Beads
entries.features_to_consider: Durable dependency-aware issue graph, reasons behind tasks, relationships and versioned state.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Agent OS has canonical roadmap/issues/records; use Beads only via sync adapter or borrow graph model rather than install separate truth.
entries.proposed_validation: Check license/current storage (Dolt) first and evaluate graph-query feature gap against current registry.

entries.name: OpenHands SDK
entries.features_to_consider: Python agent runtime, typed tool observations, resumable conversations, isolated workspaces, remote Agent Server.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Existing CLI worker adapters/agent server may overlap. Prefer optional worker adapter rather than framework replacement.
entries.proposed_validation: Adapter spike: one read-only task, then one isolated code-edit with approval and diff validation; compare to current agent worker.

entries.name: LangGraph
entries.features_to_consider: Durable state checkpoints and HITL interrupts, explicit synchronous/asynchronous persistence semantics.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Already registered in prior-art registry; avoid duplicate new entry. Recheck relevant sync durability behavior.
entries.proposed_validation: Borrow invariants/tests only if Orchestrator's own resume cannot meet them.

entries.name: Hatchet
entries.features_to_consider: Durable task queue, retries, rate limiting, worker slots, DAG execution, OTel; Postgres persistence.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Existing orchestrator has queue/health/retry. Added service increases operational burden.
entries.proposed_validation: Use as reference for queue lease+retry tests; install only if observed failure/load evidence proves need.

entries.name: Vibe Kanban
entries.features_to_consider: Agent task attempts, worktree+terminal+dev server, PR review/diff feedback, multi-CLI agent choice.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Upstream publicly announces sunsetting. Do not depend on service lifecycle.
entries.proposed_validation: Borrow lightweight UI concepts, preserve source provenance; prioritize current managed Paperclip or native interface.

entries.name: OpenCode
entries.features_to_consider: CLI coding worker with pluggable model adapters, plan/build permissions, subagent tools.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Useful low-cost model-backed coding worker via existing Orchestrator adapter interface.
entries.proposed_validation: Canary OpenCode agent on sandbox repo; measure compatibility, refusal errors, cost, JSON tool behavior.

entries.name: OpenClaw
entries.features_to_consider: Gateway for messages, channel pairing, session/agent routing, cron/webhook, skill packages.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Agent OS wants remote notification and messaging. Avoid second security principal system.
entries.proposed_validation: Borrow connector pattern and enforce scoped identity/authorization; no unapproved chat channel activation.

entries.name: Models.dev
entries.features_to_consider: Machine-readable model catalog via https://models.dev/api.json with costs/caps/license/modes.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Reduces manual model metadata scraping; existing Research Radar and registry stay canonical.
entries.proposed_validation: Add ETag/updated timestamp reader, schema guards, allowlist fields, provenance, disagreement/revision events.

entries.name: LiteLLM model price catalog
entries.features_to_consider: Broad per-model context, price, modality and tools metadata; JSON model_prices_and_context_window.json.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Supplement Models.dev and live providers; do not install full proxy to read prices.
entries.proposed_validation: Use as cross-check with per-source trust scoring; request signature/hash validation and pin provider IDs.

entries.name: Artificial Analysis data API
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Benchmark priors, never canonize without harness/version; possible account/API access or paid plan.
entries.proposed_validation: Get licensing and data access first, cache snapshots legally; reconcile evidence by exact model/reasoning mode.

entries.name: Simon Willison llm-prices
entries.features_to_consider: Open JSON current-v1.json and historical-v1.json effective-date provider prices.
entries.current_agent_os_fit: Historical price provenance and drift alerts; separate primary provider quotes.
entries.proposed_validation: Read-only price history adapter with source-diff evidence; do not blindly overwrite live quotes.
